pr_title: cli/zip: do not ignore close errors
pr_body:
Fixes #48106

Release note (bug fix): `cockroach debug zip` will now properly report
an error if some error is encountered while writing the end of the
output ZIP file.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/48109)

issue_context.title: cli/zip: don't ignore close errors
issue_context.body:
The various `.close()` methods called in the `zip` code swallow their errors. This means that if e.g. the utility runs out of disk space, no error will be reported.

Found by @tbg.

review_comments: That feeling when a library is well-designed 😍
